5544.d: Cave entrances are scenery objects located in Troll Country.

gt.heading: Travel
gt.text:
The cave entrance to the Troll Stronghold is visited during the Troll Stronghold quest and Eadgar's Ruse. As it can be quite tricky to get to for an unexperienced player, it can be reached by:
• Using the Trollheim Teleport and running west by climbing cliffside.
• Using the God Wars Dungeon Teleport and running south-west by go through the boulder.
• Run from Burthorpe and going through Death Plateau.
